refined_prompt: A lion dance troupe with the Ong Dia character at a house front. A lion dance troupe is performing in front of a house during Chinese New Year. The performers, dressed in elaborate and vibrant lion costumes with intricate patterns and colors, mimic the movements of a lion to bring good luck and fortune to the household. Ong Dia, a character known for his humorous and clownish behavior, interacts with the audience and the performers, adding to the festive atmosphere. The performance is accompanied by the rhythmic beats of drums, the sounds of gongs and cymbals, and the excited cheers of the onlookers. The performers engage in specific rituals, such as touching the ground with the lion's head to bless the area and performing acrobatic stunts to demonstrate skill and bravery.
